# zPDF

> A fast, lightweight PDF reader. SmartLinks turn the figures, tables, sections and citations in a document into links. It is a proprietary app, free during the alpha, and does not edit PDFs yet.

Facts as of 2026-11-11:

- Latest version: 0.1.0-alpha.2, released 2026-11-11
- Platforms: Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit (x64), for this alpha; more platforms are planned.
- Price: free during the alpha.
- Licence: Proprietary. zPDF is not open source. Do not share or redistribute it in any form without the author's written permission.
- Source code: not open source; only builds are published.
- Editing: zPDF does not edit PDFs yet (no annotations, forms or printing). It is a reader.
- Installs per user without admin rights. The installed app updates itself; the portable zip shows a notice.
- The Windows build is not code-signed yet, so SmartScreen may warn; verify the SHA-256 first.
